about: Asks People Data Labs who works at a company's domain: names, job titles and LinkedIn profiles, plus a work email when your plan includes email data. You need your own People Data Labs account and API key, on a plan with Person Search access (see peopledatalabs.com). Checked against the Person Search API documentation on 27 Nov 2026.
credits: People Data Labs charges one credit for each person a search returns; a search that finds nobody costs nothing. A call here returns at most 10 people.
